analyzed_vuln.description: Root cause is stale DefinitionMap state after expression rewrites during optimization. simplifyExpression performs constant propagation first (via expr->constantPropagate using DefinitionMap), then applies additional in-place transformations (delete_left/delete_right/vectorize/try_replace_expression, etc.) that can change or eliminate assignments/reads in the CFG without synchronously invalidating/updating DefinitionMap entries for affected variables. Later, VariableReference::constantPropagate calls DefinitionMap::getKnownDefinition, which dereferences a unique_ptr<Expression> entry that now points into poisoned/recycled pool memory, causing use-after-poison at getKnownDefinition line 51.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered in sksl2pipeline by malformed SkSL that drives optimizer rewrites and rescans (PoC: `void n(){int x;(x*=1,(x=8).s0,x);}`). Input must compile far enough to reach Compiler::optimize/scanCFG and execute simplifyExpression passes where assignment-like expressions are rewritten (e.g., `x*=1` -> read form, comma/swizzle constructs) so DefinitionMap retains a dangling known-definition expression for a local variable. A subsequent read of that variable during constant propagation causes the stale pointer dereference.
